key.name: mode
key.description: off: no animated screensaver (idle lock and display power-off still apply). one: always run hack-id. random: pick from random-hacks (empty means every hack in the catalog) and rotate every cycle-delay seconds. playlist: run the hacks in the playlist key in order, rotating every cycle-delay seconds.

key.name: hack-id
key.description: Catalog id of the hack used in mode "one".

key.name: random-hacks
key.description: Catalog ids enabled for random rotation. An empty list means all hacks in the catalog.

key.name: playlist
key.description: Ordered catalog ids used in mode "playlist".

key.name: hack-idle-delay
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before the screensaver starts.

key.name: cycle-delay
key.description: Seconds each hack runs before the next one in random and playlist modes.

key.name: lock-enabled
key.description: Lock from ncz-screensaver-idled after the idle period. Off by default: the desktop shell locks by itself (dev.sinty.lockscreen). With mode off the lock happens at hack-idle-delay.

key.name: lock-delay
key.description: Seconds after the screensaver starts before the screen locks.

key.name: lock-on-suspend
key.description: Lock the screen when the system is about to suspend.

key.name: display-off-delay
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before the displays are powered off (DPMS). 0 means never.

key.name: blackhole-color-mode
key.description: Color model used by the black hole hack. The shipped default is cygnus (the NCZ-OS 26.10 magenta and cyan palette); stylized is the vendor default and is the value at which the randomize roll may pick the palette. Any value other than stylized is treated as a pin and is never overwritten by randomize. Passed to the hack as NCZ_BLACKHOLE_COLORS; stylized leaves the variable unset.

key.name: gpu-offload
key.description: auto: hacks the display GPU can carry stay on it; heavier ones render on the fastest other GPU (NVIDIA offload variables or Mesa DRI_PRIME, per process only), except on battery. off: every hack renders on the GPU the compositor uses. prime: send every hack to the best other GPU. Or a GPU id such as pci-0000_01_00_0 (see ncz-screensaver gpus). The compositor and the session environment are never touched.

key.name: pool-gpu-class
key.summary: Screensavers used in random and playlist mode
key.description: weak: only screensavers measured to run well on weak graphics chips (about 20 ms or slower on the reference benchmark). mid: also those that need a mid-class GPU. all: every screensaver. auto: choose from the calibrated class of the GPU that renders the display, or all when a discrete GPU is used for offload. igpu-only is the old name of weak.

key.name: show-all-hacks
key.summary: Show screensavers that may run poorly on this graphics chip
key.description: The chooser lists screensavers that are flagged as too heavy for this GPU class in a separate group only when this is on. It does not change which screensavers random and playlist modes use.

key.name: render-scale-mode
key.description: auto: shader screensavers render at native resolution unless the platform data (render-defaults.tsv) caps the height, for example on a 4K panel driven by an integrated GPU. fixed: use render-scale and max-render-height exactly as set.

key.name: render-scale
key.description: Fraction of the native resolution shader screensavers render at (passed as NCZ_RENDER_SCALE). Lower values reduce GPU load and stutter on high resolution screens.

key.name: max-render-height
key.description: Cap on the render height in pixels (passed as NCZ_MAX_RENDER_HEIGHT). A non-zero value overrides the platform default in auto mode; 0 lets auto mode decide, and in fixed mode 0 means no cap.

key.name: lock-fps
key.description: Frames per second of the screensaver shown behind the lock. 0 is Auto: 30, capped at the display refresh rate, 15 on battery or on a weak GPU. NCZ_SAVER_LOCK_FPS in /etc/ncz/lock-renderer.env overrides it.

key.name: lock-render-divisor
key.description: Render the screensaver behind the lock at 1/N of the screen resolution and scale it up: 1 full, 2 half. 0 is Auto: full resolution, half on a weak GPU. NCZ_SAVER_RENDER_DIV in /etc/ncz/lock-renderer.env overrides it.

key.name: hack-options
key.description: Option values by screensaver id, validated against the schema in /usr/share/ncz-screensavers/options/ and passed to the screensaver process as environment variables. Absent means the screensaver's own defaults. The shipped default runs Black Hole with randomize=everything; a value here is pinned and is never overwritten by the randomize roll. The palette is pinned separately through blackhole-color-mode when that is not stylized.

key.name: dynamics-default
key.description: How strongly the beat layer drives a screensaver that supports it when its own per-screensaver options do not set dynamics. 0 (the default) leaves every look exactly as it was. A per-preset or per-screensaver dynamics always overrides this.

key.name: audio-reactive
key.description: Audio source for the beat layer when a screensaver's own options do not set audio. off (the default) uses the procedural virtual beat with no capture. system listens to the default output monitor (what is playing). mic listens to the default microphone ONLY when explicitly selected; a log line is printed every time capture starts. A per-preset or per-screensaver audio always overrides this.

key.name: audio-intensity
key.description: Depth of every audio-reactive mapping, 0..1. 0 is identical to off and is the safe floor for photosensitivity; the shared limiter additionally caps flashes and the tempo at 180 BPM. Only screensavers that opt in to the beat layer are affected, and dynamics-default still governs how strongly a beat-layer saver reacts.

key.name: verify-render
key.description: A few seconds after a hack starts, capture the screen; if it is entirely black treat the hack as failed and move on.
